requirements.text: When the user drags a product item (li element) from the product list, the system should initiate a drag event, capturing the product's title and price for transfer. The product items are represented as 'li' elements with the attribute 'draggable' set to 'true'. Each product item contains an image, a title, and a price, identified by data-testid attributes such as 'product-item-1', 'product-title-1', and 'product-price-1'. The drag event should capture the title and price of the product being dragged.

The system should allow users to drag and drop product items(data-testid="product-item-1", data-testid="product-item-2", etc.) into a designated drop area (id="div1", data-testid="drop-area") to add them to the cart. Upon dropping, the cart display should automatically update: the product title appears in .box2, the unit price in .box3, and the quantity in .box1. The system supports adding both different and repeated products.

"The system calculates the total price by summing the prices of all products in the cart, formatting the total to two decimal places with the appropriate currency symbol (e.g., '$80.00'), and displays the total in the <div id="allMoney"> element."

generated_cases.title: Drag valid draggable product item
generated_cases.description: Verify that dragging a product item (li element with draggable='true' and data-testid='product-item-1') successfully initiates a drag event and captures the correct product title and price.

generated_cases.title: Attempt to drag non-draggable or invalid product element
generated_cases.description: Verify that attempting to drag an element without draggable='true' or missing valid product data-testid attributes does not initiate the expected product transfer data event.

generated_cases.title: Drop single valid product into drop area
generated_cases.description: Verify that dropping a valid product item (e.g., product-item-1) into the designated drop area (id=div1, data-testid=drop-area) successfully adds it to the cart, updating .box1 with quantity, .box2 with the product title, and .box3 with the unit price.

generated_cases.title: Drop multiple different products into drop area
generated_cases.description: Verify that dropping multiple distinct product items into the designated drop area successfully adds all of them to the cart and updates the display boxes accordingly.

generated_cases.title: Drop repeated products into drop area
generated_cases.description: Verify that dropping the same product item multiple times into the designated drop area correctly handles repeated products by updating quantities and displaying them appropriately.

generated_cases.title: Attempt drop outside the designated drop area
generated_cases.description: Verify that attempting to drop a product item outside of the designated drop area (id=div1, data-testid=drop-area) does not add the item to the cart or update the cart display.

generated_cases.title: Calculate and display total price for a single cart item with valid formatting

generated_cases.title: Calculate and display total price for multiple distinct and repeated cart items
generated_cases.description: Partition for valid cart state containing multiple products (both different and repeated items), ensuring correct summation and currency formatting in <div id="allMoney">.

generated_cases.title: Calculate and display total price when the cart is empty
generated_cases.description: Partition for empty cart state, ensuring the total price is correctly calculated as zero and displayed properly with the currency format in <div id="allMoney">.

generated_cases.title: Drag minimum valid draggable product item

generated_cases.title: Drop Single Product into Cart
generated_cases.description: Test the drop area when exactly one product item (e.g., data-testid="product-item-1") is dropped into the designated drop area (id="div1", data-testid="drop-area"). Verify that the quantity in .box1, title in .box2, and unit price in .box3 update correctly.

generated_cases.title: Drop Multiple Different Products into Cart

Verify that the system handles multiple different products and updates cart elements accordingly.

generated_cases.description: Test dropping the same product item (e.g., data-testid="product-item-1") multiple times consecutively into the designated drop area (id="div1", data-testid="drop-area"). Verify that the system supports repeated products and increments quantities correctly in .box1.

generated_cases.title: Calculate total price for single product
generated_cases.description: Verify the total price displays correctly formatted to two decimal places with the currency symbol when there is 1 product in the cart.

generated_cases.title: Calculate total price for multiple products
generated_cases.description: Verify the total price is correctly summed and formatted when multiple products are added to the cart.

generated_cases.title: Normal State Transition - Initiate Drag Event
generated_cases.description: Verify that when a user drags a product item (li element with draggable='true') from the product list, the system transitions from Idle to Dragging state and successfully captures the product's title and price.

generated_cases.title: Abnormal State Transition - Attempt to Drag Non-Draggable Item
generated_cases.description: Verify that when an attempt is made to drag an element that does not have draggable='true', the system remains in the Idle state and does not initiate a drag event or capture product details.

generated_cases.description: Verify that dragging a valid product item and dropping it into the designated drop area successfully updates the cart display by adding the product title to .box2, unit price to .box3, and quantity to .box1.

generated_cases.title: Abnormal State Transition - Drop Outside Drop Area

generated_cases.title: State Transition - Repeated Products Addition

generated_cases.title: Calculate total price for multiple different items in cart

generated_cases.title: Calculate total price for repeated items in cart

generated_cases.title: Successful Drag Event Initiation for Product Item

generated_cases.title: Calculate and display total price for multiple and repeated products in cart

generated_cases.title: Drag non-draggable product item element

generated_cases.title: Drag product item missing child elements
generated_cases.description: Initiate a drag event on a product item that lacks either the product-title or product-price data-testid elements, testing the system's robustness against incomplete DOM structures.

generated_cases.title: Drop product into an invalid drop zone

generated_cases.title: Calculate Total Price with Floating Point Precision Errors
generated_cases.description: Test the total price calculation in <div id="allMoney"> when cart items have prices with multiple decimal places that could result in floating-point rounding inaccuracies (e.g., 10.10 + 20.20 + 30.30), ensuring the output is correctly formatted to exactly two decimal places.

technique_rationales.equivalence_partitioning: Partition product item inputs and cart contents into valid and invalid classes for adding items and calculating total prices.
technique_rationales.boundary_value_analysis: Test formatting and quantity limits such as single and repeated product additions, and two decimal place currency rounding limits.
technique_rationales.state_transition: Cover the states and transitions of product items being dragged, dropped into the drop area, and updating the cart display and total price.
technique_rationales.decision_table: Combine conditions such as adding different versus repeated products and verify resulting actions on cart quantities, unit prices, and titles.
technique_rationales.use_case: Cover the end-to-end user flow of dragging a product from the list, dropping it into the designated drop area, and verifying the updated cart display and total price.
technique_rationales.error_guessing: Explore plausible failures such as dragging non-draggable elements or dropping outside the designated drop area.
